claims.statement: ADR-0025 supersedes ADR-0016 (the rank-0-only revert) and defines the all-rank DDP validation policy: latent `val/x0_mae`, `val/fid`, `val/mean_reward`, and the configured checkpoint monitor are global metrics under DDP. `LatentX0MAE` and `TrainLossLogger` use `torchmetrics.MeanMetric` with `weight=batch_size` attached to the module so Lightning's reduction produces the true sample-weighted global mean `sum(loss*B)/sum(B)`.
